mcat_description.short: Modular cottages are factory-built prefabricated small residential or hospitality structures — including A-frame cottages, resort cottages, farm cottages, and glamping pods — assembled on-site using steel frames, sandwich panels, timber, or FRP, and sold as complete turnkey units.
mcat_description.long: Modular cottages in the Indian B2B market are off-site manufactured prefabricated structures designed for hospitality, farmhouse, and personal retreat applications, built using structural systems such as Light Gauge Steel Framing (LGSF), mild steel frames, engineered timber, or FRP with insulated sandwich panel walls and roofing. They are supplied as complete turnkey units — covering design, factory production, transportation, and on-site assembly — typically delivered within 30–90 days. The dominant commercial forms are A-frame (triangular silhouette) cottages for resorts and glamping sites, gable-roof resort cottages for boutique hotels, and portable farm cottages for farmhouse and agri-tourism use. Buyers are primarily resort developers, farmhouse owners, hospitality operators, and individual landowners seeking faster and more cost-predictable construction compared to conventional brick-and-mortar methods.

market_context: Modular cottages in India are a fast-growing segment of the prefabricated construction market, driven by demand from the hospitality, eco-tourism, and farmhouse sectors. The dominant structural systems used by Indian manufacturers are Light Gauge Steel Framing (LGSF) with Rockwool or PIR insulation and cement-fibre cladding, mild steel frames with sandwich panels, and engineered timber (pine wood, log construction). The A-frame (triangular/alpine silhouette) is the most commercially prominent design type, strongly associated with resort, glamping, and hill-station applications; it is the top buyer search intent signal in this MCAT. Resort cottages (gable or hip roof, multi-room) are the dominant bulk-order product for hospitality developers. Key buyer decision dimensions are structure material, floor area, insulation type, roof design, number of rooms, and installation timeline. Indian manufacturers typically offer end-to-end turnkey service (design, factory production, transport, on-site assembly) with delivery timelines of 30–90 days — a key differentiator versus conventional construction. Geographic demand hubs include hill stations (Shimla, Manali, Coorg, Rishikesh, Kasauli), coastal resorts (Goa, Kerala), and farmhouse belts (Delhi NCR, Pune, Nagpur). The market spans budget portable structures (fiber/FRP) to luxury LGSF villas, with per-sq-ft pricing as the dominant quoting convention. Prefab modular cottages are legally permissible in India subject to local municipal building bylaws and zoning regulations.
